xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DescriptionOfSingleSegment: PNB Housing provides housing loans to individuals and corporate bodies for purchase, construction, repair and upgradation of houses. It also provides loans for commercial space, loan against property and loan for purchase of residential plots.
